product_overview: VidyaSarthi is an AI-powered skill alignment portal that connects students, institutes, academic mentors, and industry partners in one platform. It helps students find opportunities, improve their profiles, and receive AI-driven guidance, while organizations can publish opportunities and manage engagement.
core_goals: Let users sign up, log in, and access the correct role-based portal
Allow students to manage their profiles, browse opportunities, apply, and track applications
Enable students to receive AI-based skill assessments, skill gap analysis, course recommendations, and resume review
Allow industry partners to create postings and manage applicant status
Allow academicians to post opportunities and provide mentorship feedback
Allow institutes to review and verify student accounts and view student statistics

features.name: Role-based authentication
features.description: Users can register, log in, and access a dashboard tailored to their role as student, industry partner, academician, or institute representative.
user_flows: Navigate to the landing page -> Open the authentication flow -> Choose the student role -> Enter registration details -> Submit the registration form -> See the student portal after sign up
Navigate to the landing page -> Open the authentication flow -> Choose the industry role -> Enter registration details -> Submit the registration form -> See the industry portal after sign up
Navigate to the landing page -> Open the authentication flow -> Choose the academician role -> Enter registration details -> Submit the registration form -> See the academician portal after sign up
Navigate to the landing page -> Open the authentication flow -> Choose the institute role -> Enter registration details -> Submit the registration form -> See the university portal after sign up
Navigate to the landing page -> Open the authentication flow -> Choose the student role -> Enter login details -> Submit the login form -> See the student portal after login
Navigate to the landing page -> Open the authentication flow -> Choose the industry role -> Enter login details -> Submit the login form -> See the industry portal after login
Navigate to the landing page -> Open the authentication flow -> Choose the academician role -> Enter login details -> Submit the login form -> See the academician portal after login
Navigate to the landing page -> Open the authentication flow -> Choose the institute role -> Enter login details -> Submit the login form -> See the university portal after login
While logged in -> Choose to log out -> Return to the landing page

features.name: Student profile management
features.description: Students can view and update their profile details, including skills, professional links, resume information, and preferred role.
user_flows: Navigate to the student portal -> Open the profile view -> Review current profile information
Navigate to the student portal -> Open the profile view -> Update skills and professional links -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile information
Navigate to the student portal -> Open the profile view -> Update the desired role or resume details -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile information

features.name: Opportunity browsing and application
features.description: Students can browse available opportunities and apply to postings that match their interests and skills.
user_flows: Navigate to the student portal -> Open the postings view -> Browse available opportunities -> Select a posting to review -> Apply to the posting -> See the application appear in the applications list

Navigate to the student portal -> Open the postings view -> Browse available opportunities -> Select a posting to review -> Open the skill gap analysis for that posting -> Review the fit score and gap summary

Navigate to the student portal -> Open the postings view -> Browse available opportunities -> Select a posting to review -> Open the course recommendations for that posting -> Review the suggested courses

features.name: Student application tracking
features.description: Students can view the status of their submitted applications and track progress over time.
user_flows: Navigate to the student portal -> Open the applications view -> Review submitted applications and their current statuses

features.name: AI skill assessment
features.description: Students can take AI-generated skill tests and review their assessed scores for specific skills.
user_flows: Navigate to the student portal -> Open the skill assessment section -> Choose a skill to test -> Answer the generated questions -> Submit the test -> See the assessed score
Navigate to the student portal -> Open the skill scores view -> Review previously assessed skill scores

features.name: AI resume review
features.description: Students can submit resume text for AI scoring and feedback to improve their resume quality.
user_flows: Navigate to the student portal -> Open the resume review section -> Enter resume content -> Submit the resume for review -> See the resume score and feedback

features.name: AI skill gap analysis and course recommendations
features.description: Students can compare their skills against a posting and receive AI-generated guidance on what to improve and which courses to take.
user_flows: Navigate to the student portal -> Open the postings view -> Select a posting -> Open the skill gap analysis -> Review the fit score and missing skill areas
Navigate to the student portal -> Open the postings view -> Select a posting -> Open the course recommendations -> Review the recommended courses

features.name: Industry posting management
features.description: Industry partners can create and review their own job, internship, or apprenticeship postings.
user_flows: Navigate to the industry portal -> Open the posting creation flow -> Enter posting details and required skills -> Submit the posting -> See the new posting listed among company opportunities
Navigate to the industry portal -> Open the postings view -> Review all created postings

features.name: Industry applicant review
features.description: Industry partners can review applications submitted to their postings and update each applicant's status.
user_flows: Navigate to the industry portal -> Open the applications view -> Review applicants for a posting -> Change an applicant's status to shortlisted, rejected, or selected -> See the updated application status

features.name: Academician opportunity posting and mentorship
features.description: Academicians can create academic or mentorship-oriented opportunities and provide feedback to students.
user_flows: Navigate to the academician portal -> Open the posting creation flow -> Enter opportunity details and required skills -> Submit the posting -> See the new posting listed
Navigate to the academician portal -> Open the affiliated students view -> Review students from the institute -> Select a student -> Submit mentorship feedback -> See the feedback recorded

features.name: Institute student verification and statistics
features.description: Institute representatives can review students from their institute, verify or reject student accounts, and see aggregate verification statistics.
user_flows: Navigate to the university portal -> Open the students view -> Review students from the institute -> Verify a student -> See the student's verification status update
Navigate to the university portal -> Open the students view -> Review students from the institute -> Reject a student verification request -> See the student's verification status update
Navigate to the university portal -> Open the statistics view -> Review total students, verified students, and pending verifications

known_limitations.impact: These features may fail or return errors if API key is not configured
